edits.new:
No business field. The story writes the Flyway history table `flyway_schema_history_recovery`, which is a tool table and is not in the Logical Data Model. It reads the schema object list (`information_schema`) in each environment for the drift check.

| Name | Kind | In Logical Data Model v9 or Data Classification v5 | Use in this story |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flyway_schema_history_recovery` | Tool table, written | No | Flyway migration history for the recovery schema |
| `information_schema` | Schema object list, read | No | Drift check in each environment before deployment |
